scripted_turns: $figjam the Roamstay booking status lifecycle on a new board in our Roamstay Product plan, and colour the end states so support can spot them. Pending until the card is authorised, then Confirmed, which covers Upcoming and In stay. Check-in moves Upcoming to In stay. Check-out ends it as Completed. A guest can cancel while Pending or Confirmed, and the hotel marks No-show after a missed check-in. The booking doc also says: a booking stays Pending at most 15 minutes while the card is checked. While Upcoming the guest can still change dates, and while In stay the hotel can add charges to the room. A cancel within 48 hours of check-in keeps the first night's price. The hotel can mark a No-show from 6 hours after the check-in time.
